title: Polls
description: Your server's polls (/eszkoz szavazas) with live results — close open ones from here, the bot updates the card on Discord too.
whoCanClose: The creator, staff (Staff level or above under Permissions) and members with Manage Messages can close polls — the bot checks your Discord roles.
emptyText: Start a poll on Discord: /eszkoz szavazas.
hidden: Results are hidden until the poll closes.
closeText: The poll closes for good (it can't be reopened) and the bot updates the card on Discord with the final result.

server.notOpen: This poll is already closed or doesn't exist.
